Haryana Sanitation Workers Strike Over Outsourcing, Protest Intensifies

Sanitation workers in Haryana have intensified their strike, protesting the state government's decision to outsource the hiring of new workers. The Tribune reported that the Haryana government has ordered the outsourcing of new sanitation workers amidst the ongoing strike. The Print noted that sanitation workers staged a protest outside the minister's office in Faridabad. The strike has led to a deepening sanitation crisis in the state.
